scientific_integrity: General published bounds and algorithmic results are acknowledged as prior work. The new claim is an exact optimum-family and exchange-graph classification, including parity, degrees and connectivity; experimental checks do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: All-order proof applies to labeled simple circular ladders \(C_n\square K_2\) with \(n\ge4\). Exchanges replace one entire selected edge, not one endpoint. Only finite cases \(4\le n\le19\) are enumerated by the standalone verifier. A prior equivalent formulation not found by the checked searches remains possible; no independent audit or originality certification has been performed.
title: A parity transition in optimum induced-matching exchanges of circular ladders
